changelog.why: Row 18 - this allowance caps how many rungs a day may bake for a Game, and the missing-letters ladder is two rungs rather than three. It is not a smaller budget for the same ladder: the first-ezhuthu rung cannot exist on a board that has already printed every ezhuthu it is not hiding, because the rung would either charge for a fact on the screen or be the answer. daily.mix is deliberately NOT changed in the same edit - see the PR - so nothing about today's Daily moves.

Row 14 of the lexicon pipeline - the anagram ladder is now three rungs (category, first ezhuthu, meaning) and this allowance is what caps how many a day may bake. Left at 2 the dearest rung, the one that says what the word means, would never reach a puzzle. It is a ceiling rather than a promise: a rung a word cannot honestly answer is skipped, so most days still bake two.
